title: Multi-omics and machine learning-based exploration of key genes associated with abdominal aortic aneurysm.
summary: Multi-omics/MR plus multiple ML approaches prioritized PLAU for AAA; the separate GEO validation cohort and calcium-chloride mouse model provide non-clinical validation. The result supports candidate gene association, not human causality.
